verdict.rationale: Svelte ships an official `sv` CLI. Its documented commands are `sv create` for scaffolding (including a library template and creating a project from a playground URL), `sv add` for add-ons (including local add-ons), and `sv check` for diagnostics. It can install dependencies with npm, pnpm, yarn, bun or deno. The CLI docs are published in agent-consumable llms.txt form, and an official MCP package runs via npx. missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent-specific CLI features such as documented non-interactive or flag-driven automation, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in agentic workflows.
